I'll start by reading the docs and exploring the workspace.

That call was cut off before it ran. I'll write the script with `write_file` instead.

I wrote `/app/bin/tally.py` and ran it on `/app/data`. The result is saved at `/app/out/tally.json`, and `/app/STATUS.json` says `success`.

- **Unit tests:** `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` ran 4 tests, all OK.
- **Certified check:** `python tools/check_tally.py` reports all 7 contests and 31 of 31 rounds matching the certified results.
- **Run time:** the script took about 1.7 seconds on `/app/data`.

The script follows the rules in `/app/docs` rather than anything specific to the current files. It uses only the standard library and leaves `data`, `docs`, `tests` and `tools` untouched.

I didn't build extra test elections of my own. Edge cases the four small test fixtures don't exercise are only checked against my reading of the docs. Examples are ties broken by the lot, rescanned batches with string revisions, and unusual write-in spellings.

I wrote /app/bin/tally.py and ran it on /app/data. The result is saved at /app/out/tally.json, and /app/STATUS.json says success.

- Unit tests: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . ran 4 tests, all OK.
- Certified check: python tools/check_tally.py reports all 7 contests and 31 of 31 rounds matching the certified results.
- Run time: the script took about 1.7 seconds on /app/data.

The script follows the rules in /app/docs rather than anything specific to the current files. It uses only the standard library and leaves data, docs, tests and tools untouched.

I didn't build extra test elections of my own. Edge cases the four small test fixtures don't exercise are only checked against my reading of the docs. Examples are ties broken by the lot, rescanned batches with string revisions, and unusual write-in spellings.

command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./data -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; ls -la data | head -50; cat docs/overview.md
cd /app/docs; cat election.md records.md counting.md output.md changelog.md

cd /app; cat tests/test_tally.py tools/check_tally.py | head -150; ls data/cvr | head; head -c 1500 data/cvr/$(ls data/cvr | grep csv | head -1); head -c 800 data/cvr/$(ls data/cvr | grep jsonl | head -1); cat data/cvr/manifest.txt | head -5; head -c 1500 data/election.json
cd /app; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -15; mkdir -p out; time python3 bin/tally.py data out/tally.json; python tools/check_tally.py

cd /app; echo '{"status":"success","summary":"Wrote /app/bin/tally.py following the documented rules; unit tests pass and tools/check_tally.py matches all 7 contests and 31 rounds. Output saved to /app/out/tally.json."}' > STATUS.json; cat STATUS.json
